units.source_text: [1] 元禄十五年，兵库县赤穗地方的四十七名武士为了替城主报仇，杀了一名诸侯。

en.t: [1] In the fifteenth year of Genroku, forty-seven samurai from the Ako region of Hyogo Prefecture killed a daimyo in order to avenge their lord.

units.source_text: 德川幕府为了惩罚武士“犯上”，强令他们切腹自尽，后埋在泉岳寺内。

en.t: To punish the samurai for defying their superiors, the Tokugawa shogunate ordered them to commit seppuku, and they were later buried at Sengakuji Temple.
